t: This is the former Royal Mint in East Smithfield. It was designed by two architects, James Johnson and Sir Robert Smirke. Smirke was one of the leaders of Greek Revival architecture, and also designed the main block and façade of the British Museum. He was a pioneer in the use of structural iron and concrete foundations. A later resident here was Mary Anne Blakeway, who lived at the Mint from 1850 to 1870.
